title: Don Day's Wyoming Weather Forecast: Friday, October 23, 2026 | Cowboy State Daily
text:
Sunny in some areas of Wyoming on Friday and rain possible in others. Windy. Breezy overnight with a chance of rain and snow in some areas. Highs from the upper 40s to near 80. Lows from the mid 20s to near 40.
Central:
Casper: Gradually clearing skies and very windy today with a high near 66 and wind gusts as high as 49 mph. Increasing clouds and breezy overnight with a low near 34 and wind gusts as high as 40 mph.
Lander: Chance of rain mainly before 7 a.m., otherwise sunny and windy today with a high near 60 and wind gusts as high as 41 mph. Increasing clouds and breezy overnight with a chance of rain and snow, a low near 34 and wind gusts as high as 30 mph.
Jeffrey City: Sunny and windy today with a high near 59 and wind gusts as high as 47 mph. Partly cloudy and breezy overnight with a low near 32 and wind gusts as high as 36 mph.
Southwest:
Evanston: Chance of rain mainly before 9 a.m., otherwise mostly sunny today with a high near 49 and wind gusts as high as 36 mph. Mostly cloudy overnight with a slight chance of rain and snow and a low near 30.
Rock Springs: Chance of rain mainly before 7 a.m., breezy, gradually becoming sunny today with a high near 57 and wind gusts as high as 29 mph. Mostly cloudy, gradually becoming mostly clear overnight with patchy fog after 4 a.m., a slight chance of rain after 5 a.m., a low near 31 and wind gusts as high as 22 mph.
South Pass: Chance of rain mainly before 10 a.m., windy, gradually becoming mostly sunny today with a high near 49 and wind gusts as high as 39 mph. Partly cloudy and breezy overnight with a low near 31 and wind gusts as high as 34 mph.
Western Wyoming:
Pinedale: Rain likely mainly before 9 a.m., breezy today with a high near 50 and wind gusts as high as 26 mph. Mostly cloudy overnight with a chance of rain mainly before 9 p.m., patchy fog after 3 a.m. and a low near 28.
Afton: Rain near certain today with a high near 48 and wind gusts as high as 22 mph. Mostly cloudy overnight with fog, rain and snow likely gradually ending after 9 p.m. and a low near 29.
La Barge: Chance of rain, breezy, gradually becoming sunny today with a high near 52 and wind gusts as high as 32 mph. Partly cloudy and breezy overnight with a low near 26 and wind gusts as high as 22 mph.
Northwest:
Dubois: Rain likely mainly before 10 a.m., breezy, gradually becoming sunny today with a high near 50 and wind gusts as high as 30 mph. Increasing clouds and breezy overnight with a chance of rain and snow, a low near 31 and wind gusts as high as 29 mph.
Jackson: Rain today with a high near 51 and wind gusts as high as 20 mph. Rain and snow near certain overnight with patchy fog after 11 p.m. and a low near 26.
Old Faithful in Yellowstone National Park: Patchy fog before 7 a.m., snow and rain today with a high near 45 and wind gusts as high as 23 mph. Rain and snow near certain overnight with patchy fog after 11 p.m. and a low near 19.
Bighorn Basin:
Thermopolis: Sunny and windy today with a high near 68 and wind gusts as high as 38 mph. Increasing clouds and breezy overnight with a chance of rain mainly after midnight, a low near 35 and wind gusts as high as 29 mph.
Cody: Chance of rain, breezy, gradually becoming sunny today with a high near 67 and wind gusts as high as 25 mph. Blustery, cloudy, gradually becoming partly cloudy overnight with a chance of rain and snow, a low near 31 and wind gusts as high as 39 mph.
Ten Sleep: Windy, gradually becoming sunny today with a high near 69 and wind gusts as high as 41 mph. Increasing clouds and breezy overnight with a chance of rain and snow, a low near 37 and wind gusts as high as 33 mph.
North Central:
Buffalo: Red flag fire warning from noon today until 8 p.m. tonight. Gradually clearing skies, windy today with a high near 71 and wind gusts as high as 44 mph. Partly cloudy and windy overnight with a low near 34 and wind gusts as high as 39 mph.
Sheridan: Red flag fire warning from noon today until 9 p.m. tonight. Patchy fog before 9 a.m., slight chance of rain after 3 p.m., gradually clearing skies today with a high near 78 and wind from 12-17 mph. Mostly cloudy overnight with a chance of rain and snow, a low near 27 and wind gusts as high as 44 mph.
Big Horn: Red flag fire warning from noon today until 9 p.m. tonight. Slight chance of rain after 3 p.m., gradually clearing skies today with a high near 75 and wind gusts as high as 39 mph. Mostly cloudy overnight with a chance of rain and snow, a low near 29 and wind from 20-24 mph.
Northeast:
Gillette: Red flag fire warning from 11 a.m. today until 11 p.m. tonight. Gradually clearing skies, windy today with a high near 73 and wind gusts as high as 50 mph. Increasing clouds and breezy overnight with a low near 32 and wind gusts as high as 45 mph.
Newcastle: Red flag fire warning from 11 a.m. today until 11 p.m. tonight. Gradually clearing skies, breezy today with a high near 74 and wind gusts as high as 34 mph. Partly cloudy and breezy overnight with a low near 36 and wind gusts as high as 38 mph.
Sundance: Breezy, gradually becoming sunny today with a high near 72 and wind gusts as high as 41 mph. Increasing clouds and breezy overnight with a low near 32 and wind gusts as high as 41 mph.
Eastern Plains:
Torrington: Gradually clearing skies today with a high near 80 and mostly cloudy overnight with a chance of rain before 9 p.m., a low near 38 and wind gusts as high as 25 mph.
Wheatland: Gradually clearing skies, breezy today with a high near 75 and wind gusts as high as 30 mph. Partly cloudy and breezy overnight with a low near 41 and wind from 10-20 mph.
Wright: Red flag fire warning from 11 a.m. today until 11 p.m. tonight. Gradually clearing skies, windy today with a high near 70 and wind gusts as high as 46 mph. Increasing clouds and breezy overnight with a low near 32 and wind gusts as high as 45 mph.
Southeast:
Cheyenne: Gradually clearing skies today with a high near 72 and partly cloudy and breezy overnight with a slight chance of rain before 9 p.m., a low near 38 and wind from 10-20 mph.
Laramie: Gradually clearing skies and breezy today with a high near 64 and wind gusts as high as 35 mph. Partly cloudy overnight with a low near 36.
Pine Bluffs: Mostly sunny today with a high near 78 and partly cloudy overnight with a chance of rain before 9 p.m., a low near 38 and wind gusts as high as 25 mph.
South Central:
Rawlins: Windy, gradually becoming sunny today with a high near 56 and wind gusts as high as 45 mph. Mostly clear and breezy overnight with a low near 34 and wind gusts as high as 30 mph.
Saratoga: Mostly sunny and breezy today with a high near 60 and wind gusts as high as 40 mph. Mostly clear overnight with a low near 31.
Baggs: Chance of rain before 9 a.m., windy, gradually becoming sunny today with a high near 58 and wind gusts as high as 40 mph. Mostly clear overnight with a low near 30.
summary: Increasing clouds and breezy overnight with a chance of rain and snow, a low near 34 and wind gusts as high as 30 mph. Mostly cloudy, gradually becoming mostly clear overnight with patchy fog after 4 a.m., a slight chance of rain after 5 a.m., a low near 31 and wind gusts as high as 22 mph. Increasing clouds and breezy overnight with a chance of rain and snow, a low near 31 and wind gusts as high as 29 mph.
